objective: Make Subagent creation non-blocking by default and allow multiple safe tool calls from one assistant response to execute in parallel.

requirements.summary: Subagent tool input without run_mode now defaults to background and returns a task id immediately; explicit run_mode=sync still waits.
Messages and runner preserve multiple tool calls/results in one assistant turn.
Concurrency-safe tools run as same-turn batches, while unsafe, unknown, and explicit sync paths remain serial.
OpenAI-compatible and Anthropic stream tool calls are surfaced structurally and consumed by the runner.
Bubble UI matches tool results by tool_use_id so concurrent same-name tools do not update the wrong citation.

computer_use.details: Computer Use refused both Ghostty (com.mitchellh.ghostty) and Codex (com.openai.codex) app access for safety reasons, so plugin-based visual inspection could not be completed.

cleanup.preserve_reason: .pipeline-workspace contained pre-existing June 12 artifacts unrelated to this run.
